Fun coding: Get as close to $500 as you can.

This was based on a math assignment my son had for his math class. He was given a list of items he could purchase from a swap meet. The goal was to get as close to $500 as possible without going over. So, I took his assignment and created some JS to sort the prices, start at the top and work its way down to adding in prices without getting over $500. I used a recursive function to do the addition and check to be sure the total doesn't go over $500. If it does, then the program drops the amount from the array it just picked up and moves to the next one. (Since they're sorted greatest to least, you're guaranteed to have an amount less than or equal to the current amount as long as there is something left.)
